description: This file defines the UrlSigner class responsible for creating signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront resources, including methods for generating signed URLs, handling different URL schemes, and creating resources based on URL schemes.

classes.name: UrlSigner
classes.description: Class for generating signed CloudFront URLs with methods to sign URLs, handle different schemes, and create resource strings based on URL schemes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the UrlSigner with key pair ID and private key, initializes the signer object.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a signed URL for CloudFront resources, handling different URL schemes and query parameters.

methods.name: createRtmpUrl
methods.description: Generates relative URL for RTMP scheme, including query parameters.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a resource string based on the URL scheme, handling http, https, and rtmp schemes.
